borrowed_method: Input-dependent model weights with partial pooling informed by out-of-group predictions.
scope_limit: Original method combines predictive densities with Bayesian posterior inference. R2 uncalibrated rank percentiles and L2 gate are not likelihoods, posterior probabilities or a reproduction of Bayesian stacking.
candidate_component: G3 small state-conditioned coordinator with shrinkage toward G1.
experiment: Nested coffee-group G0/G1/G2/G3 comparison using the frozen recovery gap; original-model oracle only an upper-bound diagnostic.
decision: Method inspiration only; no claim that the paper establishes coffee alignment or this implementation.

borrowed_method: Estimate model competence from nearby observed prediction cases; regularize local combinations when local evidence is sparse.
scope_limit: The paper uses probabilistic prediction pools and log scores. Its sparse-neighborhood limit is equal weighting; R2 shrinkage toward a validated global weight is a task-specific adaptation.
candidate_component: G2/G3 stage support and fixed pseudo-group shrinkage.
experiment: Fit only with inner expert OOF losses and evaluate on an additional outer group holdout; compare against G1.
decision: Use locality and regularization ideas, without probability-pool or calibrated uncertainty claims.

borrowed_method: Condition acquisition decisions on currently available information; jointly useful observations can differ from greedily valuable ones.
scope_limit: Oracle knowledge is not a deployable decision rule. Acquisition counts are not measured user seconds; R2 does not reproduce the full algorithm or add legal question slots.
candidate_component: Fixed P1/P4 stage and information-budget evaluation.
experiment: Same-target complete cost curves, existing legal endpoints, predeclared gap threshold and noninferiority margin; final candidate cost retained.
decision: Reuse original method evidence from R1, with R2-specific frozen cost definitions.

borrowed_method: Term selection likelihood and reported attribute intensity are distinct observations; participant thresholds can affect CATA selections.
scope_limit: Seven online within-person image studies concern expected intensity, not actual coffee tasting. Interval-scale assumptions and exclusions limit transfer; raw data require a request.
candidate_component: Source-native CATA and nominal-response masks; no conversion of citation frequency or ambiguous zero codes into sensory intensity.
experiment: Separate complete CATA Brier and Liberica nominal-code reconstruction; exclude complete held views and preserve each source scale.
decision: Original open paper read; methodological evidence only, no dataset imported and no request sent.

borrowed_method: Compare sensory profiling methods on both configuration agreement and measured protocol burden.
scope_limit: Six milk-containing RTD products; ten trained assessors and three separate consumer method groups. Aggregate configuration correlations and whole-task timing are not individual sensory truth or this product's time savings. Source-native CATA frequency is not DA intensity.
candidate_component: Separate alignment/cost reporting and admissible auxiliary consumer profiles.
experiment: Report observed information counts without invented seconds; source-native tasks retain their own reference and population; no copying unavailable RTD rows.
decision: Author-uploaded original paper read; raw matrix and applicable training permission not established, so no training admission.
